before.image_prompt_horizontal:
Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE finished edge-to-edge illustration; no panels, no contact sheet, no identity grid, no border.
Input references are supporting character, prop and material inputs. Compose a NEW scene, not a pasted reference sheet. Each input role is specified below. Preserve approved identities, ages, clothing and paper palette; simplify faces into small almost-flat cut-paper silhouettes, never clay dolls, modeled portraits, realistic skin or smooth CGI.
MATERIAL LOCK: matte cut-paper Colombian highland craft, broad cut shapes, visible paper edges, folded strata, cast shadows between layers. Continuous organic paper terrain and deep separated mountain planes. Water, cloud, mist and atmospheric effects are also PAPER SHAPES. Fog is broad flat WHITE PAPER CUTOUTS, never cotton, wool tufts or realistic vapor. No gritty soil, photographic water, stone particles, exposed display base, plinth, table, disconnected boards or diorama frame.
Only narrative elements specified in this scene. No invented sacred patterns, gold crowns, headdresses, armor, ethnic caricatures, ritual prescriptions, maps, diagrams, deity faces in sky or symbols borrowed from other peoples. Clothing is reversible editorial adaptation, not a universal Nasa uniform. Geographical settings are narrative approximations, not exact reconstruction.
ZERO text, letters, titles, captions, labels, watermark or logos. No visible injury, corpses, dismemberment, dead infant, nudity, sexualization, animal-human hybrid, racialized attackers or spectacle of suffering.
For narrative landscape scenes: prioritize rich relationships between modest figures and vast living paper terrain. All people fully clothed, bodies/feet legible, no foreground portrait. For symbolic squares: an original material relationship, NOT third narrative scene, catalogue, cultural seal or ritual emblem.

Narrative lock: La visita del joven desconocido — Juan Petins, secuencia única; intérprete Marco Antonio Penkue. No identificar al desconocido como Trueno, Llíban o ser reptiliano.

Image 1 P10 anonymous young ADULT man's identity; Image 2 P11 young ADULT woman's identity; Image 3 L03 ridgeline environment.
An atmospheric wide establishing scene: the young adult woman in plain rust shawl, cream blouse and ankle-length dark skirt climbs an irregular narrow mountain path to meet the anonymous young adult man in gray-green modest clothing at a ridge dwelling area. EXACTLY TWO people, short dark hair man, tied dark hair woman, no children or other figures, no snakes or worms. They stop facing one another at mid-distance on the dry path, in quiet conversation. The man has no staff, rank, halo, scales or monster form. No pregnancy or sexual contact depicted.
Layered close mountain cliffs, small highland plants and a tiny distant blue water surface low in valley, branch silhouettes frame the approach. Afternoon gray-blue light with muted warm sloping land, wide horizon and subtle broad cloud-paper layers. The mystery is their meeting and the hidden depth of the territory, not an invented visual magic beam. Keep both full bodies small within the mountainous world, nobody taller than roughly one fifth of image height. ONE coherent outdoor scene, no church focus, no castle, no temple.
